record.paper_title: The Volume of Vector Fields on Riemannian Manifolds: Main Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Volume minimizers on Berger 3-spheres with mu greater than one
record.original_question: For the three-dimensional Berger sphere (S^3, g_mu) with mu > 1 and for a prescribed constant length r > 0, determine the infimum of the volume functional among all vector fields of length r. In particular, identify whether the infimum is attained and, if so, characterize the minimizers.

evidence.quote: find the infimum of the volume of vector fields of constant length for the 3-dimensional spheres with .μ > 1.
this lower bound is never attained

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S^3 \subset \mathbb{R}^4$ be the unit 3-sphere with its standard Lie group structure, and let $\{X_1, X_2, X_3\}$ be a left-invariant orthonormal frame with respect to the round metric $g_1$, where $X_1$ generates the Hopf fibration. For each $\mu > 0$, define the Berger metric $g_\mu$ on $S^3$ by
$$g_\mu(X_1, X_1) = \mu^2, \qquad g_\mu(X_i, X_j) = \delta_{ij} \text{ for } (i,j) \neq (1,1),$$
with $X_1$ remaining orthogonal to $X_2, X_3$.

Given a smooth vector field $V$ on a Riemannian manifold $(M, g)$, view $V: M \to TM$ as an immersion and define its volume by
$$\mathrm{vol}(V) = \int_M \sqrt{\det\bigl(I + (\nabla V)^T (\nabla V)\bigr)} \, dv_g,$$
where $\nabla$ is the Levi-Civita connection and the determinant is computed in any $g$-orthonormal frame.

Fix $\mu > 1$ and a constant $r > 0$. Consider the class
$$\mathcal{V}_r = \{ V \in \mathfrak{X}(S^3) : g_\mu(V_p, V_p) = r^2 \text{ for all } p \in S^3 \}.$$

Determine
$$\inf_{V \in \mathcal{V}_r} \mathrm{vol}(V).$$
Decide whether this infimum is attained, and if so, give an explicit characterization of all vector fields $V \in \mathcal{V}_r$ achieving it.
artifact.category_tag: Volume of vector fields on Berger spheres
artifact.status_search_result: Available literature treats the volume-minimization problem for unit vector fields on 3-dimensional spherical space forms and on Berger spheres $(S^3, g_\mu)$ with $\mu < 1$, where minimizers are identified (Hopf vector fields under suitable conditions). The case $\mu > 1$ is explicitly noted as remaining open: a known lower bound is not attained, and no minimizer has been identified. No publication located that resolves the $\mu > 1$ case.

status_evidence.title: Volume minimising unit vector fields on three dimensional space forms of positive curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Solves the volume minimization problem for 3-dimensional spherical space forms and for Berger metrics g_mu with mu < 1.
status_evidence.claim: Existing results cover spherical space forms and Berger spheres with mu < 1, not mu > 1.

status_evidence.title: Volume, energy and generalized energy of unit vector fields on Berger spheres
status_evidence.snippet: Studies stability of Hopf vector fields on Berger spheres; mu > 1 case is not resolved as a minimization problem.
status_evidence.claim: Stability information exists for Hopf vector fields on Berger spheres but the absolute minimum for mu > 1 is not established.
